## Data

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary statistics (example data)"
library(modelsummary)
datasummary_skim(mtcars[, c("mpg", "hp", "wt")], type = "numeric", output = "latex",
                 histogram = FALSE)
```

## Main result

```{r}
#| label: fig-main
#| fig-cap: "Fuel economy and weight (example data)"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.5
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#0072B2") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#D55E00") +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lb)", y = "Miles per gallon") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
